mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply-side slowdown that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth decelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to a demand-side slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a labor market slowdown that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth < -100k for 2mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth decelerates by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a consumer spending slowdown that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y RSAFS growth decelerates by > 2pp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a monetary policy mismatch that will lead to market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
